versionImpact.rationale: Buildchain v2.10 patch release accepts strict publish-gate channel-lineage PRs and fixes multi-surface web preview roots through CloudFront directory-index rewrites.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: Accepts same-line publish-gate/alpha and publish-gate/release source-lock PR lineage during promote-buildchain-ref governance checks.
Installs a CloudFront viewer-request directory-index rewrite so multi-surface preview roots resolve to each surface index.html without relying on extensionless S3 alias keys.

summary: Buildchain v2.10 patch release for publish-gate lineage and web-surface preview root routing.
